units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 18:6">Targ. Is. XVIII, 6</cite> <he>יעברון ס׳</he> (h. text <he>תחרף</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 3b:9">B. Bath. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>סתרי … ס׳ ובי ס׳ וכ׳</he> they tore down and built the summer house (of worship) in winter, and the winter house in summer.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:1:10">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ</cite> top <he>מן עפר קיטא לס׳</he> out of the summer’s dust the winter’s mud is made, i.e. your doing during the year is passed in review at its end.
